_comment: THE ONLY NET-NEW SOURCE of a Netherite Upgrade Smithing Template in this world (#249).
Vanilla ships exactly one recipe for this item and it CONSUMES one: seven diamond, one
netherrack and a template, for two templates. That is a duplication, not a source, and its
only starting point is a bastion chest. Netherite scrap comes out of the compacted depths and
gold comes off the E-Scrap chain, so a player can craft ingots and still upgrade nothing.
DELIBERATELY WORSE THAN DUPLICATING. Vanilla's recipe averages 3.5 diamond per template; this
one is seven diamond AND a netherite scrap for one. That is the point: the bastion stays the
fast route and vanilla's duplication stays the cheap one, and this is only ever the bootstrap.
It also costs the rarest thing in the dimension, which is what stops it being the obvious
The scrap sits where vanilla puts the template it is copying, because that is what it is doing
- pressing the pattern into the alloy the pattern is for.
